meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会先分析你的需求（页面类型、风格、受众等），然后选择合适的设计系统或 CSS 方案，生成不套模板的前端代码。它不会默认使用 AI 常见的紫色渐变、居中英雄区等套路。
howto.when: 当你要求它制作落地页、作品集或进行网站改版时触发。它不会自动启动，需要你先给出设计需求。

say.text: 帮我做一个 B2B SaaS 落地页，风格像 Linear，简洁。
say.note: Claude 会先输出一行设计解读，然后生成代码。

say.text: 给我的设计师作品集改版，保留现有品牌色，但更实验性。
say.note: Claude 会先审计现有设计，再基于保留策略调整。

say.text: 做一个政府服务网站，要无障碍优先，用 USWDS。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will first analyze your request (page type, vibe, audience, etc.), then pick the right design system or CSS approach to generate frontend code that doesn't look templated. It avoids AI defaults like purple gradients or centered hero sections.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for landing pages, portfolios, or redesigns. It does not fire automatically; you need to provide a design brief first.

say_en.text: Build a B2B SaaS landing page, Linear-style, clean.
say_en.note: Claude will output a design read line first, then generate code.

say_en.text: Redesign my designer portfolio, preserve brand colors but make it more experimental.
say_en.note: Claude will audit existing design first, then adjust based on preserve strategy.

say_en.text: Create a government service site, accessibility-first, use USWDS.
say_en.note: Claude will use official USWDS components and follow trust-first language.
